name: WF-413 — Deal Risk & Profitability Validation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Risk Validation Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const p=ctx.property??{}; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const arv=num(d.arv??p.arv); const purchasePrice=num(d.purchasePrice??d.offerAmount); const repairs=num(d.repairs??p.repairs); const closingCosts=num(d.closingCosts??0)??0; const holdingCosts=num(d.holdingCosts??0)??0; const wholesaleCosts=num(d.wholesaleCosts??0)??0; const contingencyPct=num(d.repairContingencyPercent??10)??10; const contingency=repairs!==null?repairs*contingencyPct/100:null; const totalBasis=purchasePrice!==null?(purchasePrice+repairs+(contingency??0)+closingCosts+holdingCosts+wholesaleCosts):null; const grossMargin=arv!==null&&totalBasis!==null?arv-totalBasis:null; const marginPct=arv&&grossMargin!==null?grossMargin/arv:null; const protectedMAO=num(d.protectedMAO??d.mao); const assignmentFee=num(d.assignmentFee); const buyerPrice=num(d.buyerPrice??d.dispositionPrice); const buyerSpread=buyerPrice!==null&&purchasePrice!==null?buyerPrice-purchasePrice:null; const sellerMotivation=num(seller.motivationScore??ctx.motivationScore); const titleRisk=String(ctx.titleRisk??d.titleRisk??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const occupancy=String(p.occupancy??seller.occupancy??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const flags=[]; const blockers=[]; if(arv===null)blockers.push('missing_arv'); if(repairs===null)blockers.push('missing_repairs'); if(purchasePrice===null)blockers.push('missing_purchase_price'); if(protectedMAO!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice>protectedMAO)blockers.push('purchase_price_above_protected_mao'); if(grossMargin!==null&&grossMargin<0)blockers.push('negative_gross_margin'); if(marginPct!==null&&marginPct<0.10)flags.push('thin_margin'); if(repairs!==null&&arv!==null&&repairs/arv>=0.25)flags.push('high_repair_risk'); if(titleRisk==='high'||titleRisk==='clouded')flags.push('title_risk'); if(occupancy==='unknown')flags.push('occupancy_unknown'); if(sellerMotivation!==null&&sellerMotivation<40)flags.push('low_seller_motivation'); if(buyerSpread!==null&&buyerSpread<0)flags.push('negative_buyer_spread'); const financialReady=blockers.length===0&&grossMargin!==null; const riskScore=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,blockers.length*25+flags.length*10+(marginPct!==null&&marginPct<.15?10:0)+(titleRisk==='high'||titleRisk==='clouded'?15:0))); let riskLevel='low'; if(riskScore>=60)riskLevel='high'; else if(riskScore>=30)riskLevel='medium'; let recommendation='human_review'; if(blockers.length>0)recommendation='blocked'; else if(riskLevel==='high')recommendation='reprice_or_exit'; else if(riskLevel==='medium')recommendation='proceed_with_caution'; else if(financialReady)recommendation='approved_for_next_stage'; const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(arv!==null?20:0)+(repairs!==null?20:0)+(purchasePrice!==null?20:0)+(grossMargin!==null?20:0)+(protectedMAO!==null?10:0)+(titleRisk!=='unknown'?10:0)))); const idempotencyKey='wf413:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId; return [{json:{...input,riskValidation:{status:blockers.length?'blocked':financialReady?'validated':'partial',riskLevel,riskScore,recommendation,financials:{arv,purchasePrice,repairs,repairContingency:contingency,closingCosts,holdingCosts,wholesaleCosts,totalBasis,grossMargin,marginPercent:marginPct,protectedMAO,assignmentFee,buyerPrice,buyerSpread},flags,blockers,confidenceScore:confidence,assumptions:{repairContingencyPercent:contingencyPct}},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Risk and profitability validation is deterministic scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM fields, title/occupancy data providers, financing assumptions, and production API contracts.
